title: Waddles / svc-streaming
description: Streaming data plane. stream_* series are OTLP-only (stream latency PR #758); rtc_/rtmp_/hls_/recording_/relay series are scraped from /metrics (:9090).

panels.title: Active pumped sessions
panels.description: RTMP/SRT sessions live now (stream_active_sessions, OTLP, PR #758).

panels.title: Session failures, 15m
panels.description: Accepted ingest sessions that never became a running pipeline (PR #758).

panels.title: ICE failures, 15m
panels.description: WHIP/WHEP peer connections that reached Failed.

panels.title: Session failures by protocol / reason
panels.description: config_not_found, tenant_unresolved, spec_build_failed, engine_start_failed, whip_sdp_missing, stdin_unavailable, no_database (PR #758).

panels.title: Time to first egress p50/p95/p99
panels.description: Ingest accepted -> first HLS segment published.

panels.title: SFU fanout latency p50/p95/p99
panels.description: RTP packet entering the fanout -> a WHEP viewer receiving it (1-in-16 sampled).

panels.title: Ingest handoff p99 (backpressure)
panels.description: One ingest chunk read -> written to ffmpeg stdin; rises under ffmpeg backpressure.

panels.title: Pipeline stage duration p95
panels.description: db_connect, config_lookup, tenant_resolve, spec_build, egress_start, engine_start, ffmpeg_spawn, ffmpeg_first_progress, ffmpeg_stop, teardown.

panels.title: External call duration p95
panels.description: token_ledger, ingest_auth, object_store; outcome=error is a transport failure.

panels.title: Segment media duration p50/p95
panels.description: From #EXTINF; clustered around the 2-6 s packager target (PR #758).

panels.title: Segments per second
panels.description: Two independent counters (OTLP and scraped) - they should track each other.

panels.title: Playlist age
panels.description: Stale playlist = encoder stalled; hls_playlist_age_s is the live gauge.

panels.title: RTP packets by direction
panels.description: ingress (WHIP in), egress (WHEP out), transcoded_ingest (ffmpeg rtp leg).

panels.title: Recording spool backlog
panels.description: Bytes waiting for upload to object storage.

panels.title: svc-streaming 5xx ratio
panels.description: Share of responses with a 5xx status.
